flashcard_questions.q: What term describes a chemical that kills a specific germ without harming the patient?
Who joined Ehrlich's team in 1909 and found that compound 606 worked?
What year was Salvarsan 606 made available as a drug?
Which German scientist discovered Prontosil in 1932?
Which group of drugs was developed from Prontosil?
Which bacteria was Fleming studying when he discovered penicillin?
What year did Fleming notice mould killing bacteria on his petri dish?
Which Australian scientist led the Oxford team that purified penicillin?
Which German-Jewish refugee worked with Florey to purify penicillin at Oxford?
Who was the first human patient treated with penicillin, in 1941?
How long did the penicillin supply last for that first human patient?
How much funding did the British government give Florey and Chain?
By what date had enough penicillin been made to treat all Allied casualties?
Who used X-ray crystallography to map penicillin's chemical structure?

notes: 15 cards: 7 person to discovery, 4 term to definition, 2 event to date, 2 figure. Gave Florey and Chain a card each rather than one card with two names, and dropped the Nobel year to stay inside 15.
